question: Sangeet Natak Akademi Awards (Akademi Puraskar) carries ________.

options.text: Rs. 1,00,000/- (Rupees one lakh) along with a Tamrapatra and Angavastram
Rs. 50,000/- along with a Tamrapatra and Angavastram

solution:
The correct answer is __**Rs. 1,00,000/- (Rupees one lakh) along with a Tamrapatra and Angavastram.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi Awards** (Akademi Puraskar) is an annual award given by the Sangeet Natak Akademi, India's National Academy of Music, Dance and Drama.
 
• The award is given to artists who have made significant contributions to the field of** Indian music, dance, and theatre.**
 
• The award carries a cash prize of **Rs. 1,00,000/- **along with a **Tamrapatra and Angavastram.**
 
• The Tamrapatra and Angavastram are traditional Indian awards that are given along with the cash prize to **honor the recipient's achievements.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• On **May 31, 1952**, the Indian education ministry established the **Sangeet Natak Akademi.**
 
• It started operating the following year after** Dr. P. V. Rajamannar** was named as its first chairman. 
 
• On **January 28, 1953**, it was officially opened by **Dr. Rajendra Prasad,** the country's first president, at a ceremony held in the **Parliament Building. **
